medium: Fuzzer ignores perHost (lib/fuzz.js:373 only concurrency; bin/scanner.js:565-577 never passes perHost): default 8 in-flight to one host vs spec §8 per-host 4.
maxPaths guard aborts whole run silently (lib/fuzz.js:402-403): default 5000 with scanner cap 200 dirs x 48 words can silently disable stage 4 with tested=0 on real scans; no log/warning.

fuzzed edge skipped when directory node absent (lib/fuzz.js:463-482): dirs come from directoryOf() of crawled nodes (bin/scanner.js:473-514), so deeper dirs are often not nodes -> fuzz hits become disconnected, weakening stage-8 graph adjacency (search/filters by origin still work).
low: Soft-404 probe always hits origin root, not target base path (lib/fuzz.js:270-273), so per-directory soft pages under a path prefix are not referenced.
response.size is truncated body length, not Content-Length (lib/fuzz.js:205-215), so soft-404 size compare is on capped bytes for >1 MiB pages.
Resume cannot explicitly turn stored ignoreRobots off; --ignore-robots only sets true (bin/scanner.js:449-451).
Soft-404 test uses fixed word 'nonexistent', not a random word (tests/fuzz.test.js:221); e2e admin/api assertions are not origin-scoped (294-306), so they could pass via crawl nodes.
Fuzz hits never call putBody, so no bodies/fts_docs row exists: stage-8 content search cannot match fuzz-discovered pages by body text (lib/fuzz.js:469-478).
